calls.statement:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) dn, MIN(order_ts_utc), MAX(order_ts_utc)
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) dn, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) dup_rows
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-27' AND DATE '2025-11-29'

SELECT o.status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) orders,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN o.web_order_id END) test_orders,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN o.web_order_id END) s999,
 COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) with_lines
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY 1
